summary: First-finish testing of CKD prediction app completed. Backend (6 endpoints) and frontend (6 pages, full predict->result flow) verified against public URL. All backend endpoints return correct shapes; both CKD and Non-CKD predict flows work end-to-end from the UI including model selection, sample loading, and result rendering.
passed: GET /api/schema -> 14 numerical + 10 categorical features, best_model=Random Forest, 12 available_models (Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, SVM, XGBoost, KNN, Gradient Boosting, AdaBoost, DNN (MLP), Voting Ensemble, Stacking Ensemble, DNN + XGBoost Hybrid)
GET /api/models/comparison -> 12 models each with accuracy/precision/recall/specificity/f1/roc_auc/tn/fp/fn/tp; roc_curves and feature_importance present; best_model=Random Forest
GET /api/eda -> class_distribution {ckd:250, notckd:150 = 400}, 24 missing_by_column entries, 14 numerical_stats, hemoglobin_by_class + creatinine_by_class present
POST /api/predict (CKD payload) -> prediction=CKD, probability=1.0, risk_level=High, model_used=Random Forest, 'contributions' array populated with feature/value/importance/score/direction
Home page renders: 'Nephrolytic', tagline 'A rigorous look at Chronic Kidney Disease', 12 models trained/AUC 1.00 stat cards, disclaimer
Predict page: all data-testid selectors present (predict-submit, load-sample-ckd, load-sample-normal, model-select, input-age)
End-to-end CKD flow: load-sample-ckd -> predict-submit -> /result shows verdict='Chronic Kidney Disease', probability=100%, risk='High risk', model='Random Forest'
End-to-end Normal flow: load-sample-normal -> predict-submit -> /result shows verdict='Non-CKD', probability=2.5%, risk='Low risk'
Models page: models-table with 12 rows, 'Best' badge visible, metric-select/models-bar/models-roc all present
Dashboard page: eda-stats, eda-class, eda-missing all present
About page: methodology + disclaimer sections visible

failed.issue: Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits 'width(-1) and height(-1) should be greater than 0' warnings on Result, Models, and Dashboard pages during initial render
failed.evidence: Multiple console warnings during page load; charts still render correctly in screenshots. Non-blocking but noisy in console.

action_items: Optional: set explicit minHeight/aspect on Recharts ResponsiveContainer parents (Result gauge, Models bar/ROC, Dashboard charts) to silence width/height=-1 warnings.
